reference.use: Visual reference for architectural geometry, colors and sign layout only. Screenshot pixels are not embedded; no Google Maps imagery was fetched.

scope: W42 frontage east of the existing Madame Tussauds additions, the southwest W42/Seventh corner of 5 Times Square, and 25 m of its Seventh Avenue return.

sources.supports: MINISO's first-floor flagship store at 5 Times Square, opened in May 2023. The red interior and shelving are authored reference interpretations.

Six-piece display system, nominal corner-wrap size, slanted top and surrounding horizontal screens. The source city geometry determines the actual corner location; the page's southeast-corner wording is inconsistent with that geography.

placement.cornerShape: Original sharp oblique corner retained. W42 setbacks are separate source planes, not bridged by new building volume.
placement.displayAdaptations: Offset sign planes meet outside the actual sharp corner. The W42 main horizontal panel is 14.706 m wide; the shorter separate oblique panel is reduced to 5.95 m. No screen spans across a source wall setback.
